post.description: OHLCV candles for one instrument between two Unix timestamps. Each series is a separate array; the same index across them is one candle.

tradingSymbol.description: Trading symbol from the instrument list.

interval.description: Candle length: m = minutes, h = hours, D/W/M = day, week, month. 3M, 6M and 1Y are passed to the broker without the translation the others get and may come back empty; build them from 1M candles instead.

fromTime.description: Start of the range, Unix epoch seconds.

toTime.description: End of the range, Unix epoch seconds. Candles that open after it are left out.

fields.description: Accepted but not used: every series is always returned.

post.description: Call and put contracts at every strike for one expiry, with a live quote and open interest on each leg, the underlying's quote and the at-the-money strike marked.

tradingSymbol.description: The underlying: a stock's trading symbol (RELIANCE-EQ), an index (NIFTY) or any F&O contract on it. For MCX commodities the chain is built on the nearest future.

expiry.description: Expiry date, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out for the nearest expiry.

strikeCount.description: Strikes to return on each side of the at-the-money strike, so up to 2 × strikeCount + 1 rows (fewer near the edges of the chain). A positive number; leave it out for the full chain.

get.description:
Where to download the instrument list (the scrip master): a CSV of every scrip HIGH knows, per category. Use it to look up the `tradingSymbol` the trading and data operations take.

This operation needs no credentials, and neither do the files it points at. The files are rebuilt every trading weekday by about 08:40 IST and do not change intraday — download once a day and cache.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. The catalogue in x-error-codes is the documented set; the gateway may emit others, so SDKs generate constants from it rather than a closed enum.

Envelope.description: Every successful response is wrapped in this shape. OpenAPI has no generics, so operations inline it with a concrete `data` and this entry serves as documentation only.

requestId.description: Correlation id for this request. Quote it in support tickets.

data.description: The operation's payload. Its type varies per operation and is not always an object.

Ohlcv.description: Open, high, low, close and volume for the current session.

Touchline.description: Last traded price and session change for one scrip. Open-interest fields are present for derivatives only.

ScripInfo.description: Reference data for one tradable instrument. Equity-only fields (isin, sector, industry) and derivative-only fields (underlyingSymbol, expiry, strikePrice) are both optional.

scripCode.description: Broker token. Note: a string on Order and Trade.

segment.description: ES = equity spot, FO = futures and options.

ScripMap.description: Reference data for the scrips named in the response, keyed by trading symbol.

AccessToken.description: A 24-hour access token for the Open API.

Order.description: One order from the order book.

exchangeSegment.description: Exchange segment as returned by the broker. Wider than the tradeable set: a book shared with other Choice channels can carry NSECDS, BSECDS or MCX.

scripCode.description: Broker token as a string. Note: an integer on ScripInfo.

error.description: Rejection reason. null for Traded and Transit orders, and absent when the broker returned none.

avgTradedPrice.description: Present once any quantity has traded.

details.description: Broker-supplied order detail block. Usually null.

legIndicator.description: Which leg of a bracket or cover order this is. Absent on regular orders.

mainLegOrderId.description: Order id of the entry leg, for bracket and cover legs.

OrderPlacementResult.description: Result of placing or modifying an order. A large order may be sliced into several exchange orders.

error.description: Empty when the order was accepted.

orderIds.description: Every order id created, including slices.

OrderCharges.description: Estimated statutory and broker charges for one order.

OrderMargin.description: Margin required for a basket of orders, with the SPAN summary across them.

PnlSnapshot.description: Booked and unrealised profit and loss. Used by positions.

InvestmentSnapshot.description: Invested and current value with day and total change. Used by holdings.

Funds.description: Cash, margin and charge balances for the trading account.

shortfall.description: Margin shortfall blocking the conversion, if any.

PositionExitResult.description: One square-off attempt. `error` is present only on failure, and `tradingSymbol` may be empty for derivatives the broker did not name.

error.description: Present only when the square-off failed.
error.example: Position could not be squared off. Please try again.

MarketStatus.description: Session state per exchange for the given date.

exchangeStatus.description: Keyed by exchange code (NSE, BSE, NSEFO, BSEFO, NSECDS, MCX).

timeRemainingInSeconds.description: Seconds until this session's state changes.

isMock.description: True during an exchange mock session. Null or absent when unrecorded.

QuoteMap.description: Quotes keyed by trading symbol. Derivative entries carry open-interest fields; cash entries do not. OHLC requests add an `ohlcv` block to each entry.

MarketDepth.description: Five levels of bids and asks with aggregate pressure.

HistoricalCandles.description: Columnar candles: every array has the same length, and index i across the arrays describes one candle.

oi.description: Open interest per candle. Derivatives only.

OptionLeg.description: One side (call or put) of an option-chain row. A strike with no contract on this side is an empty object, and touchline is absent when the quote feed has no entry for the strike.

isATM.description: Present only on the at-the-money row.

InstrumentFile.description: One downloadable instrument list. `bytes` and `checksum` describe exactly what the URL served when the list was built, so a caller can verify a download and skip one it already holds.

url.description: Direct HTTPS download. Needs no API key and no access token. Treat it as opaque and read it from here rather than hardcoding it — it can move.

bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes.

checksum.description: MD5 of the file contents, hex encoded.

updatedAt.description: When this file was last published.

InstrumentsManifest.description: Where to download the instrument list (the scrip master) and what each file contains. Rebuilt every trading weekday by about 08:40 IST; it does not change intraday, so download once a day and cache it.

columns.description: The CSV header, in file order. Validate a downloaded file's header against this rather than assuming a fixed column order.
